messages:
Hiro T: hey all, first day in the Tokyo hub. following the observability onboarding but running into two weird things: Grafana dashboards load but embedded panels (images/iframe) show a blank box, and Datadog log explorer returns 403. Sentry says "project not found" when I click the inference-runtime link. my SSO is hiro.t@redwood.ai and i'm on the office network (not VPN). anyone seen APAC office-specific perms or proxy issues?

Devex Bot: welcome @Hiro T! please post your email and the exact dashboards/projects you need. onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. If you're on a corporate network, tag @Infra Ops and @SRE Oncall. :wave:

Hiro T: thanks — email above. need read access to Grafana folder "inference" (embed panels like /d/inference/embed) and Datadog logs for inference-prod. Sentry project slug i clicked was inference-runtime-prod but it might differ.

Alice B: hi @Hiro T, congrats and welcome! quick checklist: 1) try incognito to rule out stale cookies, 2) do you hit any browser console errors when iframe blanks? sometimes our image-proxy blocks cross-site frames on office proxies. 3) which office IP range are you on? we have an allowlist for Datadog ingestion in some regions.

Hiro T: incognito same. console shows "Refused to display 'https://grafana.redwood.internal' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'sameorigin'" and a few "Mixed Content" warnings for image endpoints. office IP shows 203.0.113.42 on the support sheet.

Alice B: that indicates either the proxy is rewriting headers or we need to add the office IP to our CDN allowlist for embedded resources. also the X-Frame-Options for internal grafana is expected; our embed service proxies panels and adds allow headers — if the proxy strips that, embeds break. i'll escalate to Infra Ops.

Infra Ops: thanks @Alice B and @Hiro T. i'm seeing blocked requests from 203.0.113.0/24 due to a recent firewall tightening for third-party image proxies. i'll add 203.0.113.42 to the allowlist for grafana.redwood.internal and the image-proxy. give it ~5m to propagate. additionally, Datadog 403 sounds like the office IP isn't allowed for API calls — we'll check the IP allowlist there too.

SRE Oncall: FYI we pushed a stricter outbound proxy rule yesterday to prevent metadata exfil, which incidentally removed the X-Forwarded-For header for a few APAC subnets. That header is used by Datadog's allowlist integration. infra will re-enable it for the office subnet shortly.

Hiro T: thanks. i ran this quick test after the first change (no token printed here):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}"
  -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>"
  "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Hiro T: returned 403 before infra changes. re-tested after a few minutes and it now returns 200. Grafana embeds also render correctly f0:checked; Sentry link now resolves to inference-runtime-prod project and i can see errors.

Alice B: great to hear! ownership note: infra-observability owns the dashboards. small visual tweaks can go through a PR to repos/infrastructure/grafana-dashboards exporting the JSON; if you need edit permission on Grafana itself ping me and i'll request grafana-editor for you.

Hiro T: can i get edit temporarily? want to add p95 and p99 lines and update a tooltip for a noisy alert. i'll open a PR if edits should be reviewed.

Infra Ops: granted temporary grafana-editor to hiro.t@redwood.ai for 24h. please coordinate with @Alice B for alert changes — we lock alert edits during oncall windows.

SRE Oncall: for future onboarding in APAC, we'll add a note to the obs onboarding doc about the proxy/X-Forwarded-For quirk and include the office IP ranges to avoid this rabbit hole.

Hiro T: all set here — Datadog + Grafana + Sentry access working and i have temporary editor perms. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! closing the loop. :bow:
